rv.q: Erika Dickerson-Despenza's Katrina Cycle kicks off with a gorgeous production at the Public.

The production, directed by Candis C. Jones, is both disorienting and breathtaking as it walks the porous border between magic and cold physical reality that Dickerson-Despenza conveys in her regularly poetic (and then suddenly, brutally prosaic) script.
This says two things to me – how expansive Dickerson-Despenza’s talent, and how Davis could explain why the Public Theater’s staging of “shadow/land” makes a difference...
